scope.assigned: Equipment of the carriers in your book

status.title: Service status
status.reasonRequired: Say why this unit is going out of service — at least five characters. It stays on the record and is shown on the loads it is released from.
status.doneAndReleased: Status changed, and the unit was released from {count} live load(s).

form.createSubtitle: A unit is added pending verification. It cannot be put on a load until someone has checked it.
form.carrierNotAllowed: That carrier is not one you can add equipment for.
form.unitNumberHint: As it is painted on the door. Unique within the carrier.
form.unitTaken: That carrier already has a unit {unit}.
form.vinHint: Not required, but it is how the unit is identified outside your own numbering.
form.vinTaken: That VIN is already on file as unit {unit}.

verification.title: Check against the policy
verification.hint: That this unit's VIN appears on the carrier's current certificate of insurance. A truck that is not on the policy runs uninsured, and nobody finds out until there is a claim.
verification.requiredToActivate: This unit cannot be put in service until somebody has checked it against the carrier's policy.
verification.reasonRequired: Write why it goes in service without the check. It stays with the unit.
verification.overridden: Unit put in service with the check overridden.
verification.confirm: I have seen this VIN on the policy
verification.overrideHint: Who did it and why is recorded, and shows on the unit from now on.
verification.no_coi_on_file: This carrier has no certificate of insurance on file. Ask for it and upload it before verifying.
verification.coi_expired: This carrier's certificate of insurance has expired. The new one is needed.
verification.overriddenOn: Put in service unverified on {date} by {name}.
verification.notExtracted: The system does not read the certificate: a person does. Open the document and check the VIN is on it.
verification.coi_not_approved: This carrier has a certificate of insurance that has not been approved yet. Review it before verifying the unit.
